info.title: Atom API Reference
info.description: Comprehensive APIs for domain discovery, marketplace integration, portfolio management, registration, and AI-powered domain intelligence.

get.description: Add a new domain to Atom. For premium listing, a coin will be deducted from your account and the domain will be submitted for review. For a Standard or Geo listing, the domain landing page will immediately go live
Remove a Standard listing from your account. This method only supports Standard listings. For removing Premium Listings, please contact Atom team to give a 7 day removal notice

Update the selling price of a domain. There are no restrictions for Standard Listings. For Premium Listings, the selling price must be within the allowed range as per your Membership Tier (e.g. Silver, Gold, Platinum)

example.description: Cirro.com is a dynamic, five-letter, two-syllable domain that evokes imagery of clouds and elevation—perfect for brands aiming to inspire. With its airy connotation, Cirro embodies innovation and limitless potential, making it ideal for tech startups, cloud services, or wellness brands focused on holistic growth. The name's brevity enhances memorability, ensuring easy recall and branding versatility. Cirro captures a sense of uplift and clarity, inviting users to dream big and soar high. This domain isn’t just a web address; it’s a launchpad for visionary ideas and transformative experiences. Grab Cirro.com and elevate your brand today!

SteelVerdict.com embodies strength and resilience, merging the unyielding nature of steel with the finality of a verdict. This powerful domain name evokes trust and decisiveness, making it perfect for startups in legal tech, construction, or manufacturing. Imagine a platform that streamlines legal processes with cutting-edge technology or an innovative construction firm setting new industry standards. SteelVerdict.com inspires confidence, suggesting that users can rely on its services to forge solid foundations—both literally and metaphorically. With its memorable sound and impactful imagery, this domain is set to become a cornerstone for any ambitious brand ready to make a bold statement...

parameters.name: query

parameters.name: domain_name
parameters.description: Domain name (e.g., example.com) or domain ID

post.description: Reserve a domain when a customer adds it to their cart or while you verify payment. The hold prevents the domain from being purchased by another buyer while you process the transaction.
Confirm the purchase once payment has been collected and funds are verified. This finalizes the transaction and secures the transfer authorization code for your buyer.

parameters.name: payment_amount
parameters.description: Custom payment amount if different from the listed selling price

post.description: Release a previously reserved domain back to the marketplace. Use this if the customer decides not to proceed with the purchase.
Retrieve the authorization code needed to transfer a purchased domain to the buyer's registrar of choice.

get.description: Get an AI-powered appraisal for any domain name. Returns an estimated market value, domain quality score, key signals (length, brandability, extension), and root word analysis.

Discover domains using natural language queries. Describe what you're looking for — such as 'names for a healthcare startup' or 'short brandable tech names' — and get back the most relevant matches from Atom's marketplace using advanced AI-powered semantic search.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'tech startup names’, ‘healthcare companies’) Example: tech startup names

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Optional filters to apply to the search (JSON string)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (default: 1). Default value: 1. Example: 1

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100). Default value: 20. Example: 20

get.description: Retrieve domains that were newly listed on the Atom marketplace on a specific date. Use this to stay up to date with fresh inventory and highlight new arrivals.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format to get listings for Example: 2025-07-21

parameters.name: listing_type
parameters.description: Filter by listing type. ‘Curated’ returns only Atom-curated premium domains. ‘All’ returns all newly listed domains. Default: All

get.description: Retrieve list of all partnership orders, including key details such as order status, total price, and created date. Use this endpoint to power order history views or internal reconciliation tools.

parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of orders per page (default: 20, max: 100)
